content: No C++ rendering ENGINE/LIBRARY found that offers an application-level 'pick CPU rasterizer' fallback the way MNN falls back across inference backends. The only genuine CPU rendering fallback pattern in the ecosystem is at the DRIVER/ICD level: bundle/require a software Vulkan implementation (Google SwiftShader or Mesa lavapipe/llvmpipe) as an alternate Vulkan ICD, so the SAME Vulkan API calls a real GPU would receive get executed on the CPU instead -- selected by the Vulkan loader (ICD enumeration / VK_ICD_FILENAMES), not by application code choosing a different rendering backend/library.
